name: Apex
author: vucko-adv
_about: Apex (Zeiger 0.50.4: Apex and Apex Sport in one theme, the style a Customise pick, apexStyle): a racing cluster, a rev band of blocks across the top that fills on a spring with a bright head at its front, flashing toward the shift point; the speed in the middle, the gear and P R N D M right of it, two bars left, coolant and fuel / range along the bottom. Clean: white, a thin white tray line. Sport: yellow, a red glow rising from a red tray line. Drawn in cluster-design/apex/build.html (?v=sport, ?d=1), merged by merge.js; the palette by "themeBy". Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
